mapper.sql: SELECT MEMBER_ID AS memberId, LOGIN_ID AS loginId, NICKNAME AS nickname, NAME AS name, BIRTH_DATE AS birthDate, GENDER AS gender, PHONE AS phone, MEMBER_ROLE AS memberRole, MEMBER_STATUS AS memberStatus, IDENTITY_VERIFIED_YN AS identityVerifiedYn, IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_METHOD AS verificationMethod, IDENTITY_VERIFIED_AT AS verifiedAt, IDENTITY_VERIFIED_BY AS verifiedBy, CI_HASH AS ciHash FROM HM_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE HM_MEMBER SET NAME = #{name}, BIRTH_DATE = #{birthDate}, GENDER = #{gender}, PHONE = #{phone}, IDENTITY_VERIFIED_YN = 'Y', IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_METHOD = 'ADMIN_TEMP', IDENTITY_VERIFIED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, IDENTITY_VERIFIED_BY = #{adminMemberId}, IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_REASON = #{reason}, CI_HASH = #{ciHash}, UPDATED_BY = #{adminMemberId}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND MEMBER_ROLE = 'USER' AND MEMBER_STATUS <> 'WITHDRAWN' AND IDENTITY_VERIFIED_YN = 'N' AND IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_METHOD IS NULL

UPDATE HM_MEMBER SET IDENTITY_VERIFIED_YN = 'N', IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_METHOD = NULL, IDENTITY_VERIFIED_AT = NULL, IDENTITY_VERIFIED_BY = NULL, IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_REASON = NULL, CI_HASH = NULL, UPDATED_BY = #{adminMemberId}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND MEMBER_ROLE = 'USER' AND MEMBER_STATUS <> 'WITHDRAWN' AND IDENTITY_VERIFIED_YN = 'Y' AND IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_METHOD = 'ADMIN_TEMP'
